method: Direct Python route handlers against the actual local database using the student role and SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY. Independent fresh session per run; second of two runs reported. After sessions explicitly opt into the same request cache enabled for GET/HEAD dependencies. Excludes HTTP transport, authentication, serialization, and browser rendering.
account_scope: Existing account 1; no account details or content exported.
limitations: After measurements precede the final optimization deferring full score evidence in paper summaries and the tree; a final rerun was blocked at tool approval and was aborted.
These are representative local measurements, not a load test or browser navigation timings.
